Subject: Need help with a wrongful termination case

Hello, my name is Fatima Rathore. I am a 41-year-old college lecturer living in Kolhapur. My employer Mehra Pharma Ltd owes me INR 9,50,000/- after firing me, and the dismissal followed a one-sided domestic enquiry. My case number is Complaint No. 1791/2020 in the Kolhapur Labour Court. Can your firm advise me on what to do next? You can call me on 84839 81532 or email fatima.rathore@example.in.
